text.div: Patient Document generated by Health Intersections Patient Health Document Generator

I worked 45 years in construction and heavy industry before retiring last month. My body shows the wear - bad knees, sore back, and my hearing isn't what it used to be from all the machinery noise. I lost two fingers on my left hand and my appendix in a workplace accident back in '78. I'm looking forward to spending time with my grandkids and working in my garden, but I know I need to take better care of my health now. My wife Maggie keeps me on track with my medications.

Patient's Goals

  • Manage arthritis pain to stay active (in progress)
  • Improve hearing with proper aids
  • Maintain independence in daily activities
